states.legend: Sfere: rosso · carica positiva; viola · carica negativa. La distanza parte dai centri. Nella prova del campo, il piccolo punto verde indica la posizione P della sonda. La freccia viola più vicina alla sonda rappresenta E, alla stessa scala durante la prova. Quando compare, la seconda freccia, ocra e più lontana dalla sonda, rappresenta E ×10: lo stesso campo ingrandito dieci volte. La lettura numerica è il campo nella posizione P. Il punto P è a metà fra le due cariche. Resta fisso mentre si varia la carica a destra.

findings.raster: All six full setup images with expanded legend were read; ochre P and green E are visible in the current scene while the legend assigns the field-demo colours of another branch.

nativeCaveat: Nonzero native cue is present, not wholly absent. At320 only a minute green pointed cap is visible next to P and direction is not reliably readable. The wide frames show its short, broad cap. No claim of entire head hidden by the body: all34 source-derived head vertices lie outside the analytic P sphere (minradius≈.0918> .09). The source-derived analytic test is not a faceted-mesh occlusion proof; raster read independently.
physicalZero: At q_right=+1 nC the two nonzero source contributions cancel, E_x=0 and no arrow is appropriate. All observed zero cases are correct.

manualArithmetic.formula: E_x=22.5(1-q_right_nC) kN/C from two centers each2cm away and workingk≈9e9
manualArithmetic.interpretation: Right positive; the right-source contribution points left for positive q_right. This is signed vector superposition, not addition of magnitudes.
